finding: The current native arm already pays for an exact Python continuation planner before native evaluation; native evaluates an already optimally compressed first-action witness set under the supplied deterministic scalar model.

code_references.detail: _Planner.solve caches batch/resident-set/session-ready continuations; frontier returns a least-cost complete witness per first action.
_build_request calls planner.frontier even when the caller omits planner.exact; current call plus unavoidable close are charged before literal zero-effect abstain.
AdvisoryController.decide calls exact first, avoids native if its optimum starts with skip, builds compressed request, then compares native output to the already known minimum.
finite_plan_request enumerates Python paths or delegates to Python dynamic-frontier compaction; <=8 states, <=4 batches, <=127 paths reserving an abstain slot, <=1 MiB support.
Dynamic-frontier is Python-side search with explicit generated-label and retained-frontier budgets.

non_solutions: Deleting only planner.exact leaves exact DP inside _build_request.frontier and also removes the existing ex-ante skip decision.
Switching to the existing finite-plan API does not move search into native code.

Enumerating every path into the existing request is not a complete general replacement: two optional artifacts permit up to five nominal actions at each of four batches (5^4=625 nominal sequences before feasibility pruning), beyond the 127-path interface bound. No silently truncated search, shrunk cohort, or changed original acceptance denominator is acceptable.

minimum_separate_candidate.name: versioned raw-model native adapter with the same bounded recurrence
implementation_boundary: Keep the current 1629 native profile, its negative results, and its original gates immutable.

Add a separately pinned bridge profile that receives the detached bounded model and artifact identities; transfer the finite _Planner recurrence and request witness construction into Rust before the existing NDU evaluator.
Keep Python bounded input validation, cheap optimistic _gate, actual wall-budget guards, response validation, and independent artifact/proof/resource admission. A returned plan grants no authority.

Return an explicit witness, state-generation binding, chosen first action, charged common/variable costs, and whether NDU evaluation occurred. Independently replay bounded witness feasibility and all resource transitions before preparation or dispatch.

Keep exact Python DP as an independent reference/control, not a hidden computation inside the native decision critical path. If an optimality comparison is retained as experimental instrumentation, separate it from deployment path while charging it in campaign/verification cost; if it is required online for admission, include it in native service cost and do not claim its removal.
semantic_requirements: Preserve finite integer bounds and checked arithmetic; reject bool-as-integer, overflow, malformed fields, stale generation, unknown artifact identities, incomplete search, and resource quota violations.

Match the original scalar objective, first-action completeness, stable ties and ordering, Q32 conversion behavior, literal zero-effect abstain, session state, readiness invalidation, retirement, holding, prepare/proof costs, and terminal session-close cost.
Do not apply already-paid call/close costs twice, and do not omit them from abstain or skip after native startup.

Removing the ex-ante Python exact-skip gate can start a native process in states that previously skipped. This is a material invocation-cadence change and must be registered and fully charged, including extra startup/close and failed or aborted work.
minimum_separate_candidate.why_smallest_real_architectural_change: It moves the existing bounded search rather than inventing a new optimizer, while retaining the original NDU evaluator. It can measure reduced Python/search overhead, but by itself does not establish an NDU-specific decision advantage over the same exact recurrence in Rust.

arms: Rust exact DP without NDU evaluation
Rust raw-model adapter plus original NDU evaluation
fair_experiment.common_information: Same preregistered candidate library, code/proof identities, observations, model fields, cost estimates, workload lengths/seeds, memory/time budgets, compiler flags, and initial resident/session states; no extra candidate or feedback only for NDU.
fair_experiment.quality_and_safety: Check every selected action and refusal, all admitted resource transitions, and exact-model agreement where claimed; include ties, overflow boundaries, no-feasible-plan, invalidation/recovery, cold startup, warm residency, abstain, and actual budget exhaustion.
fair_experiment.cost_accounting: Measure validation, serialization, transport, native search/evaluation, response replay, preparation, proof, code loading, execution, invalidation, retirement and close; retain every failure and cancelled work; charge all build/calibration and declared acquisition costs. Account for host startup/import/final-output outer receipts and declare remaining unknown lifetime costs.
fair_experiment.registration: Freeze the new protocol, source pins, host/toolchain, complete denominator and gates before timing. A pilot with a smaller bounded graph is a distinct result, not closure of the original workload.
fair_experiment.stop_condition: If Rust exact DP yields the same actions with less complete cost, report that outcome. A native speedup of an exact planner cannot be relabeled as an NDU-specific or globally optimal-program benefit.

retained_primary_result.scope: These existing results are retained unchanged. No candidate experiment or cross-host causal improvement is inferred.
